question: How can I disable the feedback component on a specific page in my Fern documentation?
ground_truth: To disable the feedback component on a specific page, set `hide-feedback: true` in the frontmatter of that page.

metadata.cited_context: By default, every Markdown page of your docs contains a feedback component at the bottom of the page. To disable this feature on a page, set `hide-feedback: true` in the frontmatter of that page.
